title: Taskalisk rendering
description: A rendered view, carried as a field and never as bare text: the ROADMAP block (--emit-roadmap) or the Mermaid flowchart (--emit-mermaid). Only when the plan is ok.

run.description: The execution this line belongs to (Parley spec 2.1).

legend.description: One Markdown line naming each node colour of a status-coloured Mermaid flowchart, to paste with it. Written by the Rust binary's --emit-mermaid only (flyingrobots/taskalisk#68).

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (Parley spec 4.5).
